info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Strategy Insights API
info.description: The Product Strategy Insights API provides businesses with detailed information on their product strategy based on specific parameters. This endpoint allows users to fetch insights that guide product direction and decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and strategists who need to understand market trends and align their product offerings accordingly. By utilizing this API, organizations can effectively manage their product portfolio and respond swiftly to changing market demands.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the details of a specific product strategy identified by its unique ID. It provides comprehensive information vital for understanding the strategy's objectives and plans.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to retrieve the product strategy for the specified product ID (PROD-700045). It should be structured according to the schema defined in the components section.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested product strategy.

GetProductStrategyByIdRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the Operations GET request related to the product strategy.
